title: The Bridge Gives Way
text: The great bridge, older than any House, groans and drops a span into the river. Half the city's trade crossed it.

temptation.label: Run your own ferry while the bridge is down.
temptation.text: A tidy profit, as long as the bridge stays down a while.

triumph.text: The new span is finer than the old.

holds.text: Timber trestles carry the trade until better can be built.

calamity.text: The river is a wall. The markets starve.
